items.html: And after the vessel is corrected with the verse of Baruch Shem, then we afterward say the verse 'Into Your hand I entrust my spirit, etc.,' to raise there, within that vessel that was now renewed, our souls, so that they too are renewed now at night; and afterward, in the coupling of the day, the vessel is already corrected, as mentioned, and then new souls are brought out, except that they are only in the secret of back to back, as above, for after the destruction it is only in this manner.
